evals.prompt: I have a shot of a detective walking through a rain-soaked alley at night. Turn it into a prompt that makes it look like a movie scene with dramatic moody lighting and shallow depth of field.
evals.expected_output: A production-grade Seedance 2.0 video prompt (~15-25 lines) for the rainy-alley detective scene, opening with a 2-second hook and including distinct camera, lighting, and timeline/beat sections with cinematic film-style language (anamorphic feel, shallow depth of field, moody key/fill lighting, letterbox/film grain).
expectations: Output is a single Seedance 2.0 prompt formatted with labeled sections such as camera/movement, lighting, and a timed beat-by-beat timeline rather than prose.
Opens with an explicit 2-second hook beat described at the start of the timeline.

Uses cinematic film vocabulary (e.g. shallow depth of field, anamorphic, dramatic/moody key lighting, film grain or letterbox) consistent with the cinematic style and NOT social/viral or fashion-lookbook framing.
Specifies a defined camera move (dolly, Steadicam, crane, push-in, or tracking) tied to the alley scene.

evals.prompt: I want an epic wide establishing shot of a lone astronaut on a red desert planet at golden hour, with lens flare and a slow crane reveal. It should feel like a Hollywood blockbuster.
evals.expected_output: A ~15-25 line Seedance 2.0 prompt for the astronaut-on-a-desert-planet shot, leading with a 2-second hook, with explicit camera (slow crane reveal), lighting (golden hour, lens flare), and a sequential beat timeline, all in blockbuster film-quality cinematic language.
expectations: Includes a crane/reveal camera movement and lens flare as called out in the request.
Contains an explicit 2-second hook as the first timeline beat followed by additional timed beats.
Has clearly separated camera, lighting, and timeline sections totaling roughly 15-25 lines.
Frames the look as epic/blockbuster cinematic (e.g. golden hour, anamorphic, widescreen) rather than 3D/CGI render or anime styling.

evals.prompt: Take this footage of two people talking across a diner table and give it a tense noir film look — high contrast black-and-white, hard shadows, slow push-in on the woman's face.
evals.expected_output: A ~15-25 line Seedance 2.0 prompt for the diner conversation rendered in tense noir style, opening with a 2-second hook and breaking out camera (slow push-in), lighting (high-contrast black-and-white, hard chiaroscuro shadows), and a beat-by-beat timeline.
expectations: Describes a noir aesthetic: high-contrast black-and-white, hard/chiaroscuro shadows, dramatic low-key lighting.
Specifies a slow push-in on the woman's face as the primary camera move.
Begins with a 2-second hook beat and continues with a timed cinematic timeline.
Reads as a cinematic film-look prompt (noir, film grain, letterbox) and not a music-video beat-sync or e-commerce product framing.
